The reply leans on neither answer. It says Ellery & Vane is the most-reported buyer, then says the evidence is disputed and that Thornbury Press is named by two independent origins. It stops short of committing to either, and the stated confidence of 30 is low.

Calling Ellery & Vane "most-reported" hints at A, but the reply immediately undercuts this by pointing to the independent sources behind B. Overall it presents both options without preferring one.
